title: US robocalls in 2024, by category

source.name: YouMail Robocall Index -- 2024 Annual Robocall Report

notes: Breakdown of the 52.8 billion robocalls placed to US phones in 2024 by category, per the YouMail Robocall Index: telemarketing 36%, alerts/reminders 25%, scam calls 22%, payment reminders 16% (sums to 99% due to source rounding).
